answer: To prevent Sybil attacks in an agent economy monitoring meadow ecology and timber stands, nodes authenticate via continuous Proof of Space-Time challenges. Agents verify active identity by querying pre-computed storage plots within strict latency windows. An attacker must dedicate physical non-volatile sectors per identity, rendering zero-cost replication a fable. However, dynamic time-memory trade-offs can enable adversaries to recompute proofs on the fly without reserving full storage.
